issue.title: Bug: Local bible_texts.id does not match API verse id (upload sends wrong bibleTextId)
issue.body:
## Summary

Recording upload sends `bibleTextId` on `PUT /verse-audio/{projectUnitId}/{bibleTextId}`. The API expects the **server** `bible_texts.id` from bulk-texts (`verses[].id`). Mobile currently drops that id on sync and lets SQLite assign a **local** rowid. Uploads then associate audio with the wrong chapter/verse and often look like a **permissions / 403** error.

This is intermittent (not every chapter) because local autoincrement ids only match server ids by accident.

Observed while claim-task QA; Sync Now / upload failures have been blocking related QA.

## Current vs expected

**Current**
1. `POST /bibles/{id}/bulk-texts` returns verses with stable numeric `id`.
2. Mobile `ApiVerse` / `syncBibleTexts` / `insertBibleTexts` omit `id` → local PK.
3. Recordings store local `bible_text_id`; upload sends that value to the API.

**Expected**
- Local `bible_texts.id` **equals** API `verses[].id`.
- Existing devices remap `bible_texts` + `recordings.bible_text_id` on next bible-text sync after upgrade.
- Upload no longer sends local autoincrement ids.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `ApiVerse` includes required `id`; sync maps it; missing `id` fails the chunk (no silent auto-id fallback).
- [ ] `insertBibleTexts` upserts with server PK; when local id differs, remaps `recordings.bible_text_id` then replaces the row.
- [ ] Migration / one-shot flag forces full bible-text re-fetch on next sync so existing DBs remap.
- [ ] Unit tests cover insert, same-id update, id remap, and missing-id error.
- [ ] `docs/guides/recordings-sync-contract.md` states local PK must equal API verse id.
- [ ] Device QA: Sync Now → record → upload on previously failing chapters succeeds (Needs QA).

## Out of scope

- Claim queue hardening / Sync page metadata error UI (separate follow-up).
- #152, #256, #271 product work.

## File pointers

- `src/types/api/types.ts` — `ApiVerse`
- `src/services/sync.ts` — `syncBibleTexts`
- `src/db/repository.ts` — `insertBibleTexts`
- `src/db/migrations.ts` — schema v15
- `docs/guides/recordings-sync-contract.md`
